hints.title: Sequential Token Splitting
hints.text: Split the sentence into words separated by spaces. Examine consecutive triplets of tokens to match the first and second bigram components.

hints.title: Triplet Index Range
hints.text: Iterate index i from 0 up to length minus 3. Check if token i matches first and token i + 1 matches second.

hints.title: Third Word Collection
hints.text: Whenever words[i] equals first and words[i + 1] equals second, append words[i + 2] to the resulting list.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of characters in text string
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Regular expression matching with overlapping bigrams can miss immediately consecutive occurrences.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tokenizing into an array of words enables a single linear scan in O(N) time and O(N) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should split on whitespace and iterate through adjacent word triplets.
complexity.notes: Preserves the original order of appearances in text.
